args.title: Fix amount parsing for currency symbols in reports
args.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

Adjust the code to preprocess or parse amounts that include currency symbols before treating them as numeric values. This change fixes the bug where amounts like '₹' cause errors in numeric operations, such as in the totalsByCurrency function.

label: bug
file: src/api/reports.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The error about the amount not being a number likely comes from this file where amounts are expected to be numeric but sometimes include currency symbols like '₹'. Changing this file to correctly parse those amounts before numeric operations can fix the issue.
